description: Book a free in-person property valuation with a local OpenMoov agent, for owners thinking of selling (valuation_type "sales") or letting ("lettings"). Requires the user's real name, email, phone, the property's UK address (house name/number, street, city, postcode) and a preferred appointment date (YYYY-MM-DD, must be in the future, within 180 days) and time (HH:mm, 08:00–20:00 UK time). The appointment is provisional until the local agent confirms it by email. Creates a real lead — only call with genuine user details and explicit intent.

valuation_type.description: "sales" if the owner may sell, "lettings" if they may let

name: request_valuation
title: Book a property valuation appointment
